title: Rajiv Lochan Temple
geometryBasis: One approximate mapped roof outline, the archaeological inventory platform and sanctuary dimensions, the exact 2005 Qualla original, and the original elevation field.
sectionBasis: The raised platform follows the inventory dimensions. It carries a square stepped sanctuary tower with domed finial, a lime-plastered mandapa with carved posts, flanking stairs and the immediately adjoining low shrine.
limitations: The model shows the main Rajiv Lochan temple in its documented 2005 condition. It includes the sanctuary, mandapa, raised platform, entry steps and immediately attached structure visible in the photograph.

The archaeological inventory provides the platform and sanctuary dimensions. The aerial map outline constrains the approximate position and axis. Height, individual reliefs, cement repairs and far-side details remain estimated.
The original source DEM provides the site relief. The stair thresholds and repaired plinth surfaces are below its effective resolution.
